title: Biomes Unlocked
description: Makes biome-restricted resources more easily available or renewable
body:
# Biomes Unlocked

Biomes Unlocked adds several features to make biome-restricted resources more easily available or renewable.

Changes include:
- Several tree types can now spawn rarely in more biomes
  - Acacia Trees in Plains and Wooded Badlands biomes
  - Dark Oak Trees in Forest, Flower Forest, and Wooded Badlands biomes
  - Mangrove Trees in Swamp, Jungle, and Sparse Jungle biomes
  - Cherry Trees in Stony Peaks, Meadow, Windswept Hills, and Windswept Forest biomes
- Wandering Traders can now trade several new items
  - Mycelium and Spore Blossom as special items
  - Frogspawn, Cocoa Beans, Glow Berries, and Armadillo Scutes as common items
- Bee Nests are now craftable using 6 Honeycomb Blocks and 3 Honeycomb
- Red Sand is now craftable using 8 Sand and 1 Iron Nugget
- All Coral Block types are now craftable using 4 of their respective Coral or Coral Fans
- Sniffers now dig up a regular flower alongside their special flower seed when digging
  - They can dig up Azalea, Flowering Azalea, Small Dripleaf, Mangrove Propagule, Pale Oak Sapling, Bamboo, Beetroot Seeds, Allium, Blue Orchid, Lily of the Valley, Orange Tulip, Pink Tulip, Red Tulip, White Tulip, Lilac, Peony, Rose Bush, Sunflower, Pink Petals
